caption: The drawing features two main objects: an arched panel at the top and a section of a balustrade at the bottom. The arched panel contains a depiction of a bird with outstretched wings, colored mostly in shades of white and gray with black outlines and shading on the wings. Behind the bird, red and yellow rays emanate outward, and the letters "A" and "R" are placed to the left and right of the bird, respectively. Below the bird is a row of circles in red and yellow. The arch surrounding the bird is bordered in red and yellow. The lower portion of the image shows a balustrade composed of alternating red, white, and gray spindle-shaped balusters, some of which feature geometric shapes or spiral patterns in red or gray. The handrail is mainly gray with a top edge marked by a thick red line, and the left and right ends are capped with red and gray details, the rightmost capped with a rounded finial. The drawing uses a limited color palette mainly consisting of red, gray, black, yellow, and white.
title: Plate 10: Holy Ghost (Lunette): From Portfolio "Spanish Colonial Designs of New Mexico"
